data.explanation: This is a normal invoice for a custom built-in shelf that was made and installed on 26 January 2026. The total is €1,487.50, made up of €1,250.00 net plus €237.50 VAT. Transfer the full amount to the account shown, quoting the invoice number, by the deadline shown, with no deductions. If you don't pay on time, the company may send a reminder (Mahnung) and could add fees. Check that the work matches the invoice before paying. Keep the invoice, because craftsman labour costs may be deductible in your tax return.
